ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c ), OR( IF(AND($RecordType.DeveloperName = "RES_Company", AND(NOT(ISBLANK(MobilePhone)), NOT(REGEX(MobilePhone, "\\+\\d{1,8}\\d{9,14}")))), true, false) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Mobile number must be in E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890)
